newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CANTV yr net tops expectations.
newsitem.headline: CANTV yr net tops expectations.

text.p: Year end earnings figures for Venezuelan telephone company CANTV topped most recent market expectations and should send the stock soaring Wednesday, traders and analysts said.
"The market consensus was around $2.73 per American Depository Receipt (ADR) and it came in at around $3.07," said Credit Lyonnais broker Peter Ryan in New York.

CANTV, which made its Wall Street debut late last year with a $1 billion global offering, reported Wednesday year end profits of 208 billion bolivars ($435 million). Each ADR represents seven shares; the company has one billion shares outstanding.

"We're feeling pretty pleased today; our internal estimates came in pretty much bang on," said Caracas-based Santander analyst Jose Corral. He said the consensus range of nine different analysts had been $1.68 to $3.64 per ADR.
In early local trade, before New York's open, the stock had gained 89.00 bolivars, or four percent, to reach 2250.00 bolivars by 0930 EST. On Tuesday it closed in New York at 32-5/8.
Traders saw the stock continuing its two-week rise on the result. "There was good demand yesterday and not much supply so it should trade up," said Ryan.
